kind: directed formal engine checks; fixtures are not UI play

checks.name: practice has no authored pressure events, lead or caught drift
ordinary jump plus flap may establish same high route as ramp jump
no active launch contact does not establish route
designated exit jump may complete airborne, only once
early platform departure cancels rather than banks later
low path from active landing is separately acknowledged
successful fresh contextual flip banks immediately, no fake airborne estimate
collision clears pending, leaves banked score and diagnoses obstacle
under/over/short jump diagnosis uses continuous rotation and landing slope
one-circle learning uses real inputs and identical landing tolerance
actual incomplete landing gets actionable diagnosis, not generic collision
passive ledge drop does not replace the previous active jump feedback
contact following an obstacle hit keeps that flight collision diagnosis
